points.statement: Rethinking the restoration pipeline from a unified, multi-task perspective is required to bridge this gap.
points.quote: Bridging this gap requires rethinking the restoration pipeline from a unified, multi-task perspective.

points.statement: Users specify the desired operation with intuitive text prompts, and the model routes the input through task-appropriate processing pathways.
points.quote: Users specify the desired operation through intuitive text prompts such as remove the blur or enhance resolution, and the model routes the input through task-appropriate processing pathways.

points.statement: A fixed unified channel count pads heterogeneous inputs before the backbone so batches share a common layout and parameters.
points.quote: Here CC is a fixed unified channel count: heterogeneous inputs are padded to CC before the backbone so batches share a common layout and parameters.

points.statement: A shared backbone captures universal restoration priors, while dynamically routed experts learn task-specific strategies without prohibitive computational overhead.
points.quote: The shared backbone captures universal image restoration priors, while the dynamically routed experts learn task-specific strategies without introducing prohibitive computational overhead.
